sections.heading: What we keep on your device

items: Your plan: the numbers you typed, the number of people, the currency, and the exchange rate you typed.
Your choice of light or dark.
A copy of the site's pages, so it works without internet after the first visit.

blocks.text: There are general visit statistics with no personal data, and the numbers you type stay on your device. The statistics only count visits and which pages were opened.
Links to official and other sites open other websites, which have their own privacy policies. We do not send them any of your numbers.
The “Check the rate on Google” button opens a Google search for the currency rate only, with none of your numbers.
The plan file you save is kept on your own device. If you send it or share your summary with someone, that is up to you.
If you have a question about privacy, write to usalottery2027@gmail.com.
